name: Finite Element Method
description: Strong and weak forms of governing differential equations, Weighted residual and variational approaches. Ritz method. Discretization of weak form and boundary conditions. Convergence. Bar and beam elements. Truss and frame problems, Isoparametric formulation. Plane strain, plane stress and axi-symmetric problems, 3D elasticity problems, one and two-dimensional heat transfer problems. Formulation of dynamics problems. Laboratory work on solid mechanics and heat transfer problems.
